meta.privacy.title: Privacy · Felix Werthner
meta.privacy.desc: Privacy policy for Felix Werthner's website: which data is processed and what rights you have.
priv.title: Privacy policy
priv.lead: In short: this site sets no cookies, uses no tracking and loads no fonts or scripts from third-party servers. Here is exactly what data is processed anyway.
priv.controller: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
priv.hosting1: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. The provider is GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA (a subsidiary of Microsoft Corporation).
priv.hosting2: When you visit the site, GitHub processes technically necessary data, in particular your IP address, date and time of access, the requested address and information about your browser and operating system. This is needed to deliver the site and protect it from abuse.
priv.hosting3: The legal basis is my legitimate interest in providing the website securely and reliably (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data may be transferred to the USA in the process. GitHub is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; in addition, EU Standard Contractual Clauses are in place.
priv.hosting4: More information in GitHub's privacy statement.
priv.form1: If you write to me via the contact form, your details (name, email address, subject, message) are sent to the Formspree service, which forwards them to me by email. The provider is Formspree Inc., [PLATZHALTER: current address of Formspree according to their privacy policy], USA.
priv.form2: I use your details only to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you give via the checkbox in the form, and for enquiries about a possible commission also the performance of pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing me.
priv.form3: Formspree processes the data in the USA. The transfer is based on [PLATZHALTER: basis according to Formspree, e.g. EU Standard Contractual Clauses or certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework]. US authorities may be able to access this data.
priv.form4: I delete your message once it has been dealt with and no statutory retention obligations apply, at the latest after [PLATZHALTER: e.g. 12 months].
priv.form5: More information in Formspree's privacy policy.
priv.local1: This website sets no cookies. So that it can remember your choices, it stores three small settings in your browser's localStorage:
priv.local.l1: fw-lang: the selected language (German or English)
priv.local.l2: fw-theme: the selected colour mode (light or dark)
priv.local2: These values stay on your device, are not sent to me or third parties and contain no personal data. They are only stored once you use one of the switches yourself. The legal basis is § 165(3) TKG 2021 (Austrian Telecommunications Act), as the storage is strictly necessary for the function you requested. You can delete them at any time by clearing the site data in your browser.
priv.nothird: I use no analytics or tracking tools, no social media plugins and no embedded content from other providers. All fonts are hosted on the same server as the website. Links to other sites (e.g. social networks) are plain links; you only reach the provider's site once you click them.
priv.rights1: Under the GDPR you have the right at any time to:
priv.rights.l7: withdraw consent with effect for the future (Art. 7(3))
priv.rights2: Just send me an email at the address above.
priv.complaint: If you believe that the processing of your data violates data protection law, you can lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. In Austria this is the Austrian Data Protection Authority, Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, www.dsb.gv.at.
priv.updated: This privacy policy was last updated: [PLATZHALTER: month and year]
